responsibility: This C source file implements the non-Modula-2 portion of the Logitech-compatible Break facility by bridging GNU Modula-2 runtime code to the host signal API. It maintains a stack of installed break-handler procedures, hooks SIGINT to a local dispatcher that invokes the top handler, and exports enable/disable/install/uninstall entry points, with no-op fallbacks when signal support is unavailable.
same_name_distinction: This is the C runtime companion in the Break same-name group, not a Modula-2 definition file: it implements the host-dependent SIGINT handler stack and exports the low-level Break_EnableBreak/DisableBreak/InstallBreak/UnInstallBreak entry points that Break.def merely declares abstractly.
